description.zh: 奶蛙坐着抱住画板，远处是山地风景。

description.zh: 戴帽子的奶蛙隔着桌子与男子玩纸牌。

description.zh: 从昏暗街道望去，奶蛙坐在明亮的餐馆内。

description.zh: 奶蛙坐在骷髅头和小火焰旁。

description.zh: 奶蛙坐在搭有花纹织物的小船里。

description.zh: 浅色奶蛙躺在哀悼者之间，画面呈壁画风格。

description.zh: 骑驴的人物抱着一只小奶蛙。

description.zh: 奶蛙骑乘在走向有城墙城市的人群中。

description.zh: 奶蛙头骑士骑马与龙战斗。

description.zh: 浅色古典雕像把奶蛙头部与披布的人形躯干结合。

description.zh: 奶蛙半身雕像戴着高高的埃及风格装饰王冠。

description.en: A grey sculptural Naiwa figure stands in a long pleated robe.
description.zh: 灰色雕塑奶蛙身穿长褶袍站立。

title.en: Prove You Are Not a Milk Frog

description.en: Naiwa reaches toward a plaque beneath a framed grid of Naiwa portraits.
description.zh: 奶蛙向一块牌子伸手，旁边的画框内排列着奶蛙肖像。

description.en: Naiwa turns its head while wearing a blue-and-yellow headscarf and pearl.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴蓝黄头巾和珍珠，转头回望。

description.en: Naiwa peels an orange over a wooden table beside a small plate.
description.zh: 奶蛙在木桌前剥橘子，旁边放着小盘子。

description.en: Naiwa presses its hands to its open-mouthed face on a bridge beneath an orange sky.
description.zh: 奶蛙在橙色天空下的桥上张嘴捧脸。

description.en: Naiwa and a small snowman share a red scarf.
description.zh: 奶蛙与小雪人共围一条红围巾。

description.en: Naiwa sits on a red sofa surrounded by dense jungle vegetation.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在红沙发上，四周是茂密的丛林植物。

title.en: This Page Belongs to the Cat

description.en: Naiwa watches a sleeping cat curled across an open book.
description.zh: 奶蛙看着蜷在摊开书页上的睡猫。

description.en: Naiwa works at the base of a large circular wooden tub frame.
description.zh: 奶蛙在巨大的圆形木桶框架下方干活。

description.en: Naiwa stands beside a large blank canvas and a small dark handprint.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在大幅空白画布旁，画布角落有小黑手印。

description.en: Naiwa appears in a stained-glass window with coloured light falling on the floor.
description.zh: 奶蛙出现在彩色玻璃窗中，彩光落在地面上。

description.en: Parallel dark stripes bend around a front-facing Naiwa silhouette.
description.zh: 平行深色条纹绕着正面奶蛙的轮廓弯曲。

description.en: Naiwa shapes a lump of grey clay at a low wooden table.
description.zh: 奶蛙在低木桌前揉捏一团灰色黏土。

description.en: Naiwa rides a swing through a brightly coloured mountain scene.
description.zh: 奶蛙在鲜艳的山景中荡秋千。

description.en: Naiwa pulls a red thread that opens the corner seam of a room.
description.zh: 奶蛙拉着红线，将房间墙角的接缝拉开。

title.en: Rainbow Naiwa: I am about to laugh

description.en: A rainbow-colored Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “I am about to laugh out loud.”
description.zh: 彩虹配色的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“我准备大笑”。

title.en: Rainbow Naiwa: I have already laughed

description.en: A rainbow-colored Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “I am already laughing out loud.”
description.zh: 彩虹配色的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“我已经大笑”。

title.zh: 彩虹奶蛙：我差点就大笑

description.en: A rainbow-colored Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “I almost laughed out loud.”
description.zh: 彩虹配色的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“我差点就大笑”。

description.en: A rainbow-colored Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “I am laughing out loud right now.”
description.zh: 彩虹配色的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“我正在大笑”。

title.zh: 圣诞帽奶蛙：大家都在大笑

description.en: Santa-hat Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “Everyone is laughing out loud.”
description.zh: 戴圣诞帽的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“大家都在大笑”。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures stretch a large white sheet beneath a blue sky.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙在蓝天下撑开一张大白布。

description.en: Naiwa ties blue laces through a crack in a terracotta flowerpot.
description.zh: 奶蛙将蓝绳穿过陶花盆的裂缝并系紧。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures wrap their arms around opposite sides of a tree trunk.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙从树干两侧伸臂围抱。

description.en: Naiwa lies on its back in the snow with spread limbs and fan-shaped marks.
description.zh: 奶蛙张开四肢仰卧雪地，周围留下扇形划痕。

description.en: Naiwa turns a sharpener's crank while guiding a very long blue pencil.
description.zh: 奶蛙扶着很长的蓝铅笔，转动卷笔刀手柄。

description.en: Naiwa holds one fist near its body and reaches an open hand toward the viewer.
description.zh: 奶蛙一手握拳靠近身体，另一只手掌伸向观众。

description.en: A small Naiwa looks downward with one hand at its chin above a caption that says, “Nice!”
description.zh: 小奶蛙低头把一只手放在下巴处，配有“奶思”文字。

description.en: Naiwa rests on its hands and knees with its mouth open in a broad smile.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手双膝着地，张嘴露出大大的笑容。

description.en: Naiwa holds an open dark book while a bright blue tear runs below one eye.
description.zh: 奶蛙捧着打开的深色书本，一只眼睛下面挂着亮蓝色眼泪。

description.en: Naiwa balances on one leg, kicks the other leg sideways, and raises both hands with its mouth open.
description.zh: 奶蛙单脚平衡，另一条腿侧向踢出，张嘴举起双手。

description.en: Naiwa stands in three-quarter view with its small hands held slightly in front of its belly.
description.zh: 奶蛙以四分之三侧面站立，小手微微抬在肚皮前。

title.en: Naiwa makes an intricate hand sign

description.en: Naiwa holds both hands prominently in front of its face and belly, with fingers pointing in different directions.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双手显眼地举在脸前与腹前，手指分别朝向不同方向。

description.en: A small rounded Naiwa leans sideways with both hands raised over its head.
description.zh: 小小的圆润奶蛙侧倾身体，双手举过头顶。

description.en: A close-up Naiwa has half-lidded green eyes and a small downturned mouth.
description.zh: 奶蛙特写中，绿色眼睛半垂着，小嘴向下弯。

description.en: Green-eyed Naiwa holds a rice box marked “Sichuan University group meal” and lifts food with chopsticks.
description.zh: 绿眼奶蛙端着标有“川大拼好饭”的饭盒，用筷子夹起食物。

description.en: A white recolored Naiwa has a halo and feathered wings, with hands held together above an angel-mode caption.
description.zh: 白色换色奶蛙戴着光环、长着羽翼，双手合十，下方是切换天使模式的文字。

description.en: A small Naiwa holds an egg-shaped yellow companion in one hand while facing the viewer.
description.zh: 小奶蛙面向观众，一只手捧着蛋形黄色伙伴。

description.en: Naiwa holds its hands together at its chest with white feathered wings behind its shoulders.
description.zh: 奶蛙在胸前双手合十，肩后展开白色羽翼。

description.zh: 奶蛙站在树下草地上挥动双臂，下方红底配字“呼叫奶家人”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa in a rainbow helmet

description.zh: 粉色奶蛙戴着彩虹色头盔，在白色围栏前转头并张嘴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.zh: 奶蛙在书架和落地灯之间交替迈步、弯膝跳舞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Colored gourds transforming into laughing Naiwa
title.zh: 彩色葫芦变成大笑奶蛙

description.zh: 悬挂的彩色葫芦变成奶蛙，黄色及其他颜色的奶蛙在山间户外一起大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing beside a white long-eared companion
title.zh: 奶蛙与白色长耳同伴跳舞

description.zh: 奶蛙和白色长耳圆胖同伴在华丽的彩绘玻璃窗前一起摇摆、挥动手臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing with a long-eared companion in a living room
title.zh: 奶蛙与长耳同伴在客厅跳舞

description.zh: 奶蛙与浅色长耳同伴在柔和灯光的客厅中左右摇摆、挥动手臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Leather-jacket Naiwa and a mouse in green fumes
title.zh: 皮夹克奶蛙与绿烟中的老鼠

description.zh: 穿皮夹克的奶蛙转身背对小老鼠，随后绿烟罩住老鼠，老鼠脸色变黑并露出难受表情。保留公开展示的水印。

description.zh: 两只奶蛙紧挨着坐在浅色被子下，微笑着挥动双手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙走着走着抬腿踢起

description.zh: 奶蛙侧身走路，随后抬膝、高高踢起一条腿，并用双臂保持平衡。保留公开展示的水印。

description.zh: 奶蛙站在装饰丰富的门前，反复把双手抬到嘴边，并迈步靠近镜头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa leaving its prison stripes behind
title.zh: 奶蛙脱下囚服迎向阳光

description.zh: 风雨场景中，奶蛙拉扯条纹囚服，随后脱离囚服，向穿过乌云的金色阳光展开双臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 风雨奇幻场景中奶蛙拿玫瑰

description.zh: 风雨场景里，奶蛙站在高高的石建筑上，白色布料掠过；随后镜头拉近，奶蛙把红玫瑰举到脸旁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Angel Naiwa opening its praying hands
title.zh: 天使奶蛙展开合十的双手

title.en: Naiwa clutching its head in a dark corner

description.zh: 奶蛙坐在阴暗角落，双手抱住头的两侧，低下含泪的脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa falling off a bicycle on a road
title.zh: 奶蛙骑车在公路上摔倒

description.zh: 奶蛙沿乡间公路骑自行车，随后失去平衡，连人带车摔到柏油路上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a night-time square

description.en: Naiwa swings its arms and steps around in a paved square with brightly illuminated golden buildings behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在铺砖广场上挥臂迈步，身后是灯光明亮的金色建筑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙穿紫色珠宝装跳舞

description.en: Naiwa dances in an ornate purple-and-gold jeweled outfit, moving its arms and hips against a bright fantasy-city backdrop. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿华丽的紫金色珠宝装，在明亮的奇幻城市背景前挥动双臂、扭动身体跳舞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding an open purple folding phone
title.zh: 奶蛙双手拿紫色折叠手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a wide, open purple folding phone with both hands and looks down at it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手拿着展开的宽幅紫色折叠手机，低头看向手机。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a gold-and-black phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a gold-and-black phone with a prominent round camera, touching its chin with the other hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着金黑色、带大圆形摄像头的手机，另一只手摸着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa thinking over a pale-blue phone
title.zh: 奶蛙托腮看浅蓝色手机

description.en: Naiwa studies a pale-blue phone with a clustered set of camera lenses while resting a hand beneath its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着浅蓝色、带一组摄像镜头的手机，一只手托着下巴端详。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa treating a brick like a phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a reddish brick upright like a phone and touches its chin thoughtfully. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把红褐色砖块竖着拿在手中，像看手机一样托腮思考。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a white phone with a horizontal camera
title.zh: 奶蛙看横条镜头白色手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a white phone with a black horizontal camera module, resting the other hand beneath its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着带黑色横条摄像头的白色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a white round-camera phone
title.zh: 奶蛙看圆形镜头白色手机

description.en: Naiwa touches its chin while holding a pale phone with a large round black camera module. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙摸着下巴，手拿浅色手机，背面有一个大黑色圆形摄像头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding an open white folding phone
title.zh: 奶蛙拿展开的白色折叠手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a wide white folding phone with both hands; one panel shows a dark circular screen pattern. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手拿展开的白色折叠手机，其中一侧面板可见深色圆形屏幕图案。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a black phone upright and rests its other hand under its chin against a white background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 白色背景上，奶蛙竖着拿黑色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures stand facing each other; the left one bends forward and extends its tongue to the other’s outstretched hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙相对站立，左边的奶蛙俯身伸出舌头，舔右边同伴伸出的手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa licking a seated companion’s foot
title.zh: 奶蛙舔坐着的同伴的脚

description.en: One Naiwa crouches and extends its tongue toward the foot of another Naiwa sitting with legs forward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一只奶蛙蹲下伸出舌头，舔另一只双腿前伸、坐着的奶蛙的脚。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa licking a companion’s raised foot

description.en: The left Naiwa bends down to lick the raised foot of a second Naiwa standing on one leg. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 左边奶蛙俯身舔右边奶蛙抬起的脚，右边奶蛙单腿站立。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A green-striped watermelon version of Naiwa sits on a plate, with a curling vine and two pink peach-like lobes behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 西瓜条纹的奶蛙坐在盘子上，头上有卷曲藤蔓，身后有两瓣粉色桃子状造型。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa thinking over a white phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a white phone upright and rests its other hand under its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙竖着拿白色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears an old-fashioned dark robe, a tied-up hairstyle and a long black beard in a painted portrait. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风肖像中，奶蛙穿深色古装长袍、束起头发，留着长黑胡子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa lifting a foot toward its face

description.en: Naiwa bends forward on one leg and holds its lifted foot close to its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙单腿站立向前弯腰，捧起另一只脚凑近脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a suit reading with crossed legs

description.en: A Naiwa-headed figure wears a dark suit, white shirt and dark stockings while reading a book in a wheeled office chair with legs crossed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙头的角色穿深色西装、白衬衫和深色丝袜，翘腿坐在办公转椅上读书。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa looks sideways with half-lidded eyes beneath a clear, close-fitting hood with a small tip at the top. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着顶部有小尖端的透明贴头头套，半眯着眼睛看向一旁。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A cat-eared Naiwa variant puffs its cheeks and raises a paw with visible pink pads. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 猫耳造型的奶蛙鼓着脸颊，举起一只露出粉色肉垫的爪子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Rabbit-eared Naiwa posing with a raised leg

description.en: Naiwa has long rabbit ears and a fluffy tail, lifting one leg sideways while placing one hand behind its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙长着长兔耳和毛绒尾巴，一条腿向侧面抬高，一只手放在脑后。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A yellow chicken-shaped Naiwa variant has green eyes, a red comb and an upright fan of tail feathers. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色小鸡造型的奶蛙有绿色眼睛、红色鸡冠和竖起的扇形尾羽。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a spiky durian-shell hat and gives a half-lidded, downturned-mouth look. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着带尖刺的榴莲壳帽子，半眯眼睛、嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a white shirt, green waist wrap and dark trousers with three swords positioned behind its shoulder. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿白色上衣、绿色腰带和深色裤子，肩后背着三把剑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Red Naiwa soldier with folded arms

description.en: A red Naiwa variant with green eyes wears camouflage uniform, cap and tactical vest, standing with arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 红色、绿眼睛的奶蛙穿迷彩制服、帽子和战术背心，双臂交叉站立。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa leans forward in a wide stance while holding and aiming a long red rifle. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双腿分开、身体前倾，双手举着红色长步枪瞄准。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a blue superhero suit and red cape

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark-blue superhero suit, a red cape and boots, and gold shoulder details while its round pale belly remains visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深蓝色超级英雄战衣、红披风和靴子，肩部有金色装饰，圆圆的浅色肚皮露在外面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in glasses, waistcoat and tie
title.zh: 奶蛙戴眼镜穿马甲领带

description.en: Naiwa wears rectangular glasses, a blue waistcoat over a white shirt and a tie, with an oversized weapon behind its back. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴方框眼镜，白衬衫外穿蓝色马甲、系领带，背后有一把大型武器。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Blond Naiwa in an American-flag outfit
title.zh: 金发奶蛙穿美国旗图案服装

description.en: A blond-haired Naiwa variant stands with folded arms wearing red-and-white stripes and a blue panel of white stars. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 金发奶蛙变体双臂交叉站立，身穿红白条纹和蓝底白星图案服装。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A heavily muscular yellow Naiwa folds one arm and rests the other hand against its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 肌肉发达的黄色奶蛙一臂横抱，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A small, round Naiwa wears a blue police uniform, a dark peaked cap and a utility belt, with arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙穿蓝色警服，戴深色大檐帽和装备腰带，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa wearing a large flower

description.en: A pink Naiwa variant rests its hands on a tabletop, wearing a large pink flower and puffing its cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙戴着一朵大粉花，双手放在桌面上，鼓着脸颊。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa face on a swoosh shape

description.en: Naiwa’s green-eyed face is incorporated into a long yellow swoosh-shaped graphic. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的绿眼睛脸被融入一条长长的黄色勾形图案。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Bowl-cut Naiwa in a school uniform

description.en: Naiwa wears a black bowl-cut hairstyle and a blue-and-white school uniform while a hand points toward it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着黑色锅盖头，穿蓝白校服，一只手正指向它。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Blond Naiwa laughing in a black shirt
title.zh: 金发奶蛙穿黑衬衫大笑

description.en: A blond-haired Naiwa wears a black collared shirt with a small American flag patch and laughs with both hands on its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 金发奶蛙穿带小美国旗贴章的黑色有领衬衫，双手捂着肚子大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa’s green-eyed head rises from an elongated hand-shaped body with rounded finger-like tips. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙绿眼睛的头从细长的手掌形身体上立起，前端带有圆润的手指状结构。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a dark police uniform

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark-blue police uniform and peaked cap, folding its arms and narrowing its green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深蓝色警服、戴大檐帽，双臂交叉并眯起绿色眼睛。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A round yellow fish-shaped Naiwa has large green eyes, scales, fins and a fan-shaped tail. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆圆的黄色小鱼造型奶蛙长着绿色大眼睛、鱼鳞、鱼鳍和扇形尾巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink-eared Naiwa reclining with puffed cheeks

description.en: A pink-eared Naiwa variant reclines on one side, props its head on a hand and puffs its rosy cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带粉色小耳朵的奶蛙侧躺着，一只手托头，鼓起红扑扑的脸颊。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa bending beside an open toilet
title.zh: 奶蛙在打开的马桶旁弯腰

description.en: Naiwa bends sideways beside an open toilet, with a thin yellow stream arcing toward the bowl. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在打开的马桶旁侧身弯腰，一条细黄色水流弧线朝向马桶。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a black telephone receiver to its ear, with red decline and green answer buttons beneath it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把黑色电话听筒举到耳边，下方有红色拒接和绿色接听按钮。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa in a dark ninja outfit

description.en: A round chibi Naiwa wears dark ninja-style clothing, arm guards and a scarf, with swords behind its back and arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙穿深色忍者风服装、护臂和围巾，背后有剑，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa squatting in red high heels

description.en: An exaggerated long-limbed Naiwa spreads its arms and squats with legs wide while wearing red high heels. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 四肢夸张拉长的奶蛙张开双臂、双腿大开蹲下，脚穿红色高跟鞋。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with a mohawk and black tank top

description.en: Naiwa wears a black tank top and tall dark mohawk, sitting at a table with a metal bowl and chopsticks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着高高的深色莫西干发型、穿黑背心，坐在摆着金属碗和筷子的桌前。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa standing with hands on hips

description.en: Naiwa stands facing forward with both hands on its hips and its pale belly visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面站立、双手叉腰，露出浅色肚皮。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A side-facing close-up of Naiwa has a caption meaning “two striking glances.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧脸特写下方配有中文“惊鸿两瞥”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa with very large green eyes and a slightly open mouth against a dark background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 深色背景下，奶蛙特写中绿色眼睛睁得很大，嘴微微张开。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A frontal close-up of Naiwa shows large green eyes and a small open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面特写露出绿色大眼睛和微微张开的小嘴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking back with one leg lifted

description.en: Naiwa looks back over its shoulder with a small smile while lifting one bent leg. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙微笑着回头看，抬起一条弯曲的腿。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa spreads its legs wide, raises one arm diagonally and places the other hand beside its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双腿大幅张开，一只手斜向上伸直，另一只手放在头侧。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa glancing sideways in a classroom

description.en: A close crop shows Naiwa in a white garment looking sideways, with a classroom wall and poster behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，穿白色衣服的奶蛙看向侧面，身后是教室墙壁和海报。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s blank look in a library
title.zh: 奶蛙在图书馆面无表情

description.en: Naiwa stands before bookshelves with nearly closed eyes and a small downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在书架前，眼睛几乎闭着，小嘴向下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking back while bent forward

description.en: Naiwa bends forward with its back toward the viewer and turns its green-eyed face back with a smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙背对观众弯腰，微笑着转回绿眼睛的脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa lying down with both feet raised

description.en: Naiwa reclines on its back with both feet raised and one hand bracing against the ground. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰躺着抬起双脚，一只手撑在地面上。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A round-bellied Naiwa stands facing forward with its arms folded over its upper belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆肚子的奶蛙正面站立，双臂交叉放在肚子上方。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A side-facing portrait shows Naiwa with a half-lidded eye and a small straight mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 侧脸肖像中的奶蛙半眯着眼睛，嘴巴抿成小小的一条线。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa tilting its head down, eyelids lowered and mouth downturned. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，奶蛙低着头、垂着眼皮，嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: One Naiwa hugging another from behind

description.en: A larger Naiwa embraces a smaller laughing Naiwa from behind; both have closed eyes and happy expressions. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 较大的奶蛙从背后抱住较小、正在大笑的奶蛙，两只都闭着眼睛，表情开心。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s lowered eyes and open mouth

description.en: Naiwa looks downward with drooping eyelids and a small open mouth against a dark background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 深色背景下，奶蛙眼皮下垂地看向下方，嘴微微张开。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A small round Naiwa looks forward and presses one finger beside its nose. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙面向前方，一根手指贴在鼻子旁。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Two small yellow Naiwa embrace face to face and touch their puckered lips together. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只黄色Q版奶蛙面对面拥抱，撅起的嘴唇贴在一起。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with its tongue out

description.en: A close, tilted view shows Naiwa laughing with eyes closed, mouth wide open and tongue extended. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 倾斜的近景中，奶蛙闭眼张大嘴巴大笑，伸出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa standing with folded arms

description.en: A small, round Naiwa faces forward and folds its arms beneath a slight smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙面向前方，微微笑着，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa: I will never laugh again

description.en: A grayscale Naiwa gives an unhappy sideways look above a red caption meaning “I will never laugh again…” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 灰度奶蛙不开心地看向一旁，下方红底配字“我再也不会笑了…”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa leaning into a companion’s belly

description.en: One Naiwa bends forward and nestles its head against the belly of another standing Naiwa. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一只奶蛙弯下身，把头靠在另一只站着的奶蛙肚子上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with both hands on its belly

description.en: Naiwa laughs with its head raised, eyes closed and both dark hands pressed to its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰头闭眼大笑，两只深色的手按在肚子上。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa looking sideways with heavy eyelids and a pronounced downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，奶蛙眼皮低垂地看向一旁，嘴角明显下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa bending and sticking out its tongue

description.en: Naiwa bends its knees and holds its belly while laughing with its tongue extended. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙屈膝捧着肚子大笑，同时伸出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding its belly with a worried look
title.zh: 奶蛙捧肚子露出担心表情

description.en: Naiwa looks downward with drooping eyelids and holds both hands together over its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙垂着眼皮向下看，双手合拢放在肚子前。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s upside-down face between its legs
title.zh: 奶蛙从双腿间露出倒着的脸

description.en: Naiwa bends fully over, showing its upside-down green-eyed face between its feet. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙深深弯下腰，从双脚之间露出倒着的绿眼睛脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙张大嘴巴狂笑特写

description.en: An extreme close-up shows Naiwa’s wide open laughing mouth, teeth and closed smiling eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 极近特写展示奶蛙大张的笑嘴、牙齿和闭起的笑眼。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa making two peace signs over its head

description.en: Naiwa raises both hands over its head in peace signs and sticks out its tongue. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双手举到头顶比剪刀手，同时吐出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa brings one arm to its face as several large tears run beneath its green eye. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把一条手臂举到脸前，绿色眼睛下方流着几滴大眼泪。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa curled up: protection from being eaten

description.en: Naiwa curls into a round shape with hands by its head; a white caption on its body means “protection from being eaten.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙蜷成圆团，双手放在头边，身体上有白字“防吃”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A frontal close-up shows Naiwa’s large green eyes filled with tears and its small mouth turned down. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 正面特写中，奶蛙绿色大眼睛含满泪水，小嘴向下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa watching rain through a window

description.en: Naiwa sits alone beside a rain-streaked window in a dim room, with one hand resting near the windowsill. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 昏暗房间里，奶蛙独自坐在布满雨痕的窗边，一只手放在窗台附近。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙摸头安慰难过的同伴

description.en: A taller Naiwa rests its hand on the head of a smaller, downcast Naiwa beside it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 较高的奶蛙把手放在旁边较小、垂头丧气的奶蛙头上。保留公开展示的水印。
